name: Visual Coding (2-Photon Calcium Imaging)
description: Wrote custom code to standardize the mixed JSON/HDF5 metadata records for thousands of microscopy experiments and their associated visual stimuli.
Published a total of **93.4 TB** of visual cortex microscopy data on the associated NIH data archive.
Adapted a Jupyter Notebook tutorial to demonstrate how to remotely stream and analyze the dataset.
Significant portions of this tutorial later became the flagship scientific example of the DANDI archive indexed by the Open Data Program (AWS) landing page.
